item.title: Thomas, Lewis help No. 15 Virginia beat Ohio State 70-66 in Nashville
item.description: Malik Thomas and Sam Lewis each scored 13 points and No. 15 Virginia beat Ohio State 70-66 on Saturday night at Bridgestone Arena in the Nashville Hoops Showdown.

item.title: Ball and Karaban lead No. 6 UConn to a 79-75 win over Georgetown
item.description: Solo Ball had 20 points and Alex Karaban scored 13 of his 18 points in the second half as No. 6 UConn held off a second-half rally and beat Georgetown 79-75 on Saturday night.

item.title: Padres sign ex-Phillies slugger Nick Castellanos, pitchers Canning and Márquez, AP source says
item.description: The San Diego Padres have agreed to terms with outfielder Nick Castellanos and right-handers Griffin Canning and Germán Márquez, a person with knowledge of the deals told The Associated Press.

item.title: Darius Acuff Jr., Billy Richmond III have career nights as No. 21 Arkansas beats Auburn
item.description: Darius Acuff Jr. tied a career high with 31 points and Billy Richmond III scored a career-high 25 to lead No. 21 Arkansas past Auburn, 88-75.

item.title: JT Toppin puts on low-post masterclass in No. 16 Texas Tech's OT win over No. 1 Arizona
item.description: Texas Tech's JT Toppin had arguably his best all-around performance of the season with 31 points and 13 rebounds as the Red Raiders knocked off No. 1 Arizona 78-75 on Saturday.

item.title: Holloway paces Alabama's balanced attack in 89-75 win over South Carolina
item.description: Aden Holloway scored 20 points and Alabama maintained control most of the way and beat South Carolina 89-75.

item.title: No. 3 South Carolina beats No. 6 LSU 79-72, extending winning streak against the Tigers to 18 games
item.description: Tessa Johnson scored 21 points as No. 3 South Carolina beat No. 6 LSU 79-72 on Saturday night and extended its winning streak over the Tigers to 18 games.

item.title: Steinbach, Diallo pave the way for Washington to end three-game skid beating Minnesota 69-57
item.description: Hannes Steinbach scored 26 points on 12-of-17 shooting and Washington beat Minnesota 69-57.

item.title: Swain scores 18 of his 25 after halftime, Texas beats Missouri 85-68
item.description: Dailyn Swain scored 18 of his 25 points after halftime, Matas Vokietaitis had 19 points and 10 rebounds, and Texas pulled away in the second half to beat Missouri 85-68 win.
